get_config: get the default MD4 config dict for training on downsampled ImageNet 64x64
sweep: run a hyperparameter sweep over MD4 training configs for ImageNet 64x64
create_config_dataset: create a config dict with dataset settings for downsampled ImageNet 64x64
create_config_model: create a config dict with MD4 model architecture settings including layers and hidden size
create_config_training: create a config dict with training hyperparameters including learning rate and batch size
